This policy explains what data is collected, how it is used, and your choices. Effective date: August 18, 2026 1. Information We Collect Air Fryer Toolkit does not require you to create an account or provide any personal information to use the converter. We do not sell personal data. The temperature, time, food type, and air fryer style you enter are processed entirely in your browser and are never sent to a server. 2. Cookies Air Fryer Toolkit does not set any cookies of its own. If we enable the services described below, they may set the following: Google Analytics cookies ( _ga , _gid , _ga_* ) — set by Google Analytics to distinguish users and sessions. Retained for up to 2 years. See Google's Privacy Policy . Google AdSense cookies — set by Google to serve relevant advertisements and measure ad performance. See Google's Privacy Policy . You can clear cookies at any time via your browser settings. 3. Analytics Air Fryer Toolkit uses Google Analytics to understand aggregate usage patterns such as page views, popular tools, and device types. Google Analytics collects anonymised data including your approximate location (country/region), browser type, device type, and pages visited. No personally identifiable information is collected or stored by us through this service. Google's privacy policy applies: policies.google.com/privacy . You can opt out of Google Analytics tracking by installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on . 4. Advertising Air Fryer Toolkit may display advertisements through Google AdSense . Google AdSense and its partners use cookies and similar tracking technologies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and other websites. You may opt out of personalised advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings or aboutads.info/choices . Google's privacy policy applies: policies.google.com/privacy . 5. Contact Form If you use the contact form , the name, email address, subject, and message you submit are sent directly to us by email via Cloudflare's infrastructure and are not stored in a database. We use Cloudflare Turnstile to verify submissions are not automated; Turnstile does not use cookies to track you across sites. We retain contact messages only as long as necessary to respond. 6. Third-Party Services Google Fonts — loads the typeface used on this site, resulting in a request to fonts.googleapis.com that may log your IP address. Cloudflare — hosts this site and processes contact form submissions. See Cloudflare's Privacy Policy . 7. Children's Privacy Air Fryer Toolkit is a general-purpose cooking tool suitable for all ages. We do not knowingly collect any personally identifiable information from children under 13. Google AdSense may display non-personalised ads to users in regions where personalised advertising is restricted. 8. Changes to This Policy We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The effective date at the top of this page will reflect when the policy was last revised. Continued use of Air Fryer Toolkit after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy. 9. Contact For privacy-related questions, please use the contact page .
